title: vitex glabrata f. pallida
intro: Vitex glabrata f. pallida, commonly known as the Chaste Tree or Vervain, is a plant species that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic effects, making it useful in treating menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Vitex glabrata f. pallida include acting as a uterine stimulant, supporting the pituitary gland, and modulating the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
